EMPLOYEE VEHICLE LEASE FINANCING AGREEMENT 
 
 
 438150 10795 This Employee Vehicle Lease Financing Agreement sets out the terms and condition s upon which Zameen Media Private Limited agrees to provide lease financing facility for a vehicle along with v ehicle maintenance services to its eligible employees as per the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy . It is important that before entering into this Agreement , the eligible employee read s the policy and this Agreement carefully and understand s all of his/her rights and obligations. The eligible employee must also carefully understand the Lease Financing Scheme (Annexure A) , Settlement Plan (Annexure B) and Vehicle Specifications (Annexure C) , and must also execute an Undertaking of the Delivery and Receipt of the Vehicle and Promissory Note , all of which constitute an integral part of th is a greement . 
 By signing this Agreement, the eligible employee acknowledges having read, understood and accepted the terms of the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy. 
 0 20000 This Employee Vehicle Lease Financing Agreement sets out the terms and condition s upon which Zameen Media Private Limited agrees to provide lease financing facility for a vehicle along with v ehicle maintenance services to its eligible employees as per the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy . It is important that before entering into this Agreement , the eligible employee read s the policy and this Agreement carefully and understand s all of his/her rights and obligations. The eligible employee must also carefully understand the Lease Financing Scheme (Annexure A) , Settlement Plan (Annexure B) and Vehicle Specifications (Annexure C) , and must also execute an Undertaking of the Delivery and Receipt of the Vehicle and Promissory Note , all of which constitute an integral part of th is a greement . 
 By signing this Agreement, the eligible employee acknowledges having read, understood and accepted the terms of the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy.

 [Each a “Party” and , collectively , “Parties” ] 
 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Company is providing an opportunity to eligible employees to avail vehicle lease financing through Habib Bank Limited in accordance with the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy; and 
 
 The Designated Employee is a permanent employee of the Company who is desirous of availing vehicle lease financing from the Company and, in accordance with the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy, the Company, as a gesture of goodwill, agrees to facilitate the Designated Employee in availing vehicle lease financing as per the terms and conditions set forth herein. 
 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of mutual benefits, this agreement witnesses as follows: 
 
 DEFINITONS 
 
 Bank means Habib Bank Limited having its registered office at Habib Bank Plaza, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi . 
 
 Bank Account means the bank account of the Designated Employee as first mentioned above, in which the Company shall be depositing the down payment and fixed monthly lease installment for the Vehicle for the period of the Lease Financing Tenure . 
 
 Bank Lease Agreement means the lease agreement executed by and between the Bank and the Designated Empl oyee for leasing of the Vehicle. 
 
 Commencement Date means the date of signing of the Bank Lease Agreement . 
 
 Complete Lease Payment means the total payment (including down payment and all installments) to be paid to the Bank for the lease of the Vehicle during the Lease Financing Tenure . 
 
 Down Payment means 20% (twenty percent) of Complete Lease Payment paid directly by the Company to the Bank on behalf of the Designated Employee as a n interest-free loan extended by the Company and payable by the Designated Employee as and when demanded . 
 
 Early Departure means the resignation from employment of the Designated Employee from the Company during the period of the Lease Financing Tenure . 
 
 Employment Contract means the contract of employment executed by and between the Company and the Designated Employee. 
 
 Expiry Date means the date of expiry of the Bank Lease Agreement. 
 
 Initial Cost means the cost pertaining to vehicle registration and one-off tracker cost (including installation) . 
 
 Lease Financing Scheme means the monthly payment plan set out in Annexure A of this Agreement, which shall be followed strictly by the Designated Employee to make all the lease installment payments to the Bank . 
 
 Lease Financing Tenure means the lease period of FIVE years starting from the Commencement Date to the Expiry Date . 
 
 Monthly Lease Financing Installment means the monthly lease installment amount transferred to the Bank Account and to be paid by the Designated Employee to the Bank , as specified in the Lease Scheme in Annexure A . 
 
 Policy means the Company Sponsored Vehicle Policy and any other policy of the Company that may be enforced from time to time. 
 
 Settlement Plan means the repayment plan set out in Annex u re B with respect to Lease Financing Scheme in the event of Early Departure of the Designated Employee. 
 
 Vehicle means the Company- sponsored car provided to the Designated E mpl oyee, the details of which are mentioned in Annexure C of this Agreement . 
 
 Vehicle Maintenance Services means the maintenance and service charges which the Company pays to its Designated Employee during the tenure of the Lease Period . 
 
 
 DURATION 
 
 The Agreement shall endure for a period of FIVE years from the Commencement Date , unless renewed or terminated as per the terms of this Agreement. 
 
 VEHICLE REGISTRATION 
 
 The Vehicle shall be registered in the name of the Designated Employee in the record of the Excise and Taxation Department and the original documents pertaining to the vehicle registration shall be in the exclusive possession of the Company , a photocopy whereof shall be provided to the Designated Employee . It is, however, clarified that the Company shall be the real owner of the Vehicle and the Designated Employee shall be the ostensible owner there of. 
 
 DOWN PAYMENT AND MONTHLY LEASE INSTALLMENTS 
 
 
 
 The Company will transfer Down P ayment in the Bank Account of the Designated Employee on the Commencement Date , which shall be paya ble to the Bank by the Designated Employee on the dates and in the amount specified in the Lease Financing Scheme attached herewith as Annexure A . 
 
 A s per the Lease Financing Scheme , the Company will transfer a fixed Monthly Lease Financing Installment every month in Bank Account , which amount shall be paid by the Designated Employee to the Bank in accordance with the Lease Financing Scheme in Annexure A . 
 
 In the event the Designated Employee fails to transfer the Down Payment or any Monthly Lease Financing Installment, as the case may be, to the Bank on the dates specified in the Lease Financing Scheme, the Company may , at its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement . In the event of termination under this Clause 4.3, the Designated Employee shall be liable to pay any and all amount s paid by the Company to the Designated Employee under this Agreement and sh all also handover the Vehicle to the Co mpany as per the Settlement Plan annexed herewith as Annexure B . 
 
 MANTAINANCE , SERVICE AND OTHER CHARGES OF THE VEHICLE 
 
 The Designated Employee shall be fully responsible for maintaining the Vehicle i n good working condition. This includes using and servicing the Vehicle in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendations and taking all necessary action to keep the Vehicle well maintained at all times . The expenses for the regular maintenance and services of the Vehicle, including inter alia oil change, filter change, etc. of the Vehicle shall be borne by the Company during the Lease Financing Tenure. 
 
 I f the Vehicle incurs any obvious physical changes which hampers the use of the Vehicle, the Designated Empl oyee shall direct the same to the Insurance Company as provided in Clause 6 of this Agreement . 
 
 The Company shall not bear any expenses pertaining to any cosmetic changes/enhancement made to the Vehicle. However, if the Employee, at his/her own will and expense, wants to make any cosmetic changes to the Vehicle, he/she shall first seek the written approval of the Company. 
 
 Except as otherwise p rovided in Clause 5 . 2 above , the Designated Employee shall be responsible to keep the Vehicle in good workable condition at all time s . 
 
 I NSURANCE COVER, PREMIUM AND TRACKER CHARGES 
 
 The Designated Employee shall be responsible for ensuring that the Vehicle has a valid insurance cover at all times. 
 
 The Designated Employee shall also ensure that the tracking system installed in the Vehicle is functioning properly at all times . 
 
 The Designated Employee shall be responsible for obtaining insurance for the Vehicle from an insurance company acceptable to the Company. The Company shall be stipulated as the beneficiary in the insurance coverage. 
 
 The annual premium charges for the insurance cover of the Vehicle and the annual charges for the tracker installed there in shall be borne by the Company . The Company will pay insurance and tracker charges directly to the concerned vendors . 
 
 T he Designated Employee shall be responsible for comply ing with the terms and conditions and claim procedures of the insurance policy of the insurance company. 
 
 The Designated Employee shall inform the Company in writing if the insurance policy is , for any reason , cancelled or any major changes to the terms and conditions there of are made . 
 
 In case of theft, loss or damage of the Vehicle, the Designated Employee shall inform the Company as well as the insurance company immediately. In case of such an event, no replacement shall be provided to the Designated Employee by the Company. 
 
 I f for any reason, the insurance company denies any claim or payment under any claim made by the Designated Employee, the Designated Employee shall be responsible for bearing the expenses as a result of the denial of claim by the insurance company . 
 
 If the insurance company classifies the loss, theft, damage or destruction of the to be a total loss, th is Agreement may be terminated at the option of the Company and any p ayment made to the Bank Account under the Lease Financing Scheme shall be refunded to the Company at once by the Designated Employee . 
 
 UNDERTAKING S BY THE COMPANY 
 
 
 
 
 
 The Company undertakes to grant the Designated Employee the exclusive possession and use of the Vehicle during the Lease Financing Tenure . 
 
 The Company undertakes to bear all the expenses pertaining to applicable taxes/excise token, annual insurance premium, annual tracker fee and maintenance charges of the Vehicle during the Lease Financing Tenure . 
 
 
 
 
 UNDERTAKINGS BY THE DESIGNATED EMPLOYEE 
 
 
 
 The Designated Employee undertakes to punctually pay to the Bank all the Monthly Lease Financing Payments and all other amounts due and payable under the terms of this Agreement and the Bank Lease Agreement until such time as the Designated Employee’s obligation to make the payments as specified in Annexure A comes to an end . 
 
 T he Designated Employee sha ll at all times ensure that the Vehicle is used and driven in a skilful and safe manner , in accordance with all applicable traffic and safety laws, and is only drive n by person ( s ) holding a valid driving permit or license . 
 
 The Designated Employee shall not use or allow the Vehicle to be used for any purpose for which it is not designed or is unsuitable. In particular, the Vehicle shall not be used for racing, transporting of passengers for a fee, transportation of dangerous or noxious substances or any other activity which places the Vehicle at increased risk of damage or is prohibited by law . 
 
 The Designated Employee , to the best of his/her ability, undertakes to protect the Vehicle against damage from fire, theft and all other risks 
 
 The Designated Employee shall neither sell any of the components of the Vehicle to anyone nor shall make any alterations or transformations to the Vehicle with the Company’s written approval. However, if a ny part or component of the Vehicle is required to be replaced by some other part or component or by one of the same like, make and model or an improved or advanced version , the Designated Employee may have it replaced after obtaining the Company’s prior written approval. 
 
 The Designated Employee undertakes never to sell, assign, lease, mortgage or dispose of the Vehicle. 
 
 The Designated Employee shall be responsible for the pay ment of the expenses relating to fuel, t i re damage or maintenance as well as any costs of parking , parking or traffic violation fines and towing expenses for illegal parking or any other costs which are not covered under this Agreement . 
 
 The Designated Employee , at the time of the expiry of this Agreement, undertakes to return the Vehicle to the Company in a good mechanical condition except for reasonable wear and tear occurred during the period of the Lease Financing Tenure ; 
 
 The Designated Employee agrees to fully compensate the Company for any loss or damage caused to the Company as a result of the use of the Vehicle except where the loss or damage is caused by the Company’s act or omission in breach of this Agreement . 
 
 TERMINATION 
 
 This Agreement shall stand terminated in the event of Early Departure of the Designated Employee from the Company in accordance with his/her E mployment C ontract . 
 
 This Agreement shall stand terminated in the event of termination of employment of the Designated Employee by the Company in accordance with the Employment Contract. 
 
 This Agreement may also be terminated by the Company in the event of a material breach by the Designated Employee of the terms and conditions of this Agreement or the Employment Contract , or in the event of default as envisaged under Clause 6.9 or 11 hereof . 
 
 In the event of termination of this Agreement, the Company shall settle the payment as per the provisions laid out in the Settlement Plan attached as Annexure B of the Agreement, and the Designated Employee shall return the Vehicle along with all associated documentation to the Company in good condition and shall also repay any Monthly Lease Financing Installment credited in advance by the Company to the Bank Account of the Designated Employee. Alternatively, the Company may, at its sole discretion, transfer the real ownership of the Vehicle to the Designated Employee in accordance with Company policy and practice. 
 
 TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP 
 
 
 
 
 I n the event of termination of this Agreement the Designated Employee shall be liable to transfer the ownership of the Vehicle to the Company . 
 
 The Designated Employee and the Company shall co-operate fully for the transfer of the ownership of the Vehicle and shall sign and execute all documents and do all such acts as are necessary or ancillary thereto . All the costs pertaining to the transfer of the ownership of the Vehicle shall be the responsibility of the Company . 
 
 EVENTS OF DEFAULT 
 
 
 
 The Designated Employee shall be in default under this Agreement if one or more of the following occurs : 
 
 If the Designated Employee fails to punctually make the payments to the Bank as per the Lease Financing Scheme . 
 
 If the Designated Employee fail s to perform any term of this Agreement along with the Annexures and the Vehicle Car Policy attached herewith . 
 
 If any circumstance occurs which in the Company’s reasonable opinion may have an adverse impact on the value, safety or condition of the Vehicle, or which indicates that the Designated Employee shall be unwilling to comply with his/her obligations under this Agreement . 
 
 If the Designated Employee is in default of this Agreement, the Company shall send a notice to the Designated Employee requiring him/her to rectify the default within a period of 5 ( five ) calendar days from the date of such notice . After the lapse of this notice period, if the default is not rectified, the Company, in its sole discretion, may terminate the Agreement. 
 
 N OTICES 
 
 A notice given under this Agreement shall be deemed to have been served 48 (forty-eight) hours if delivered personally or sent by registered post or by a recognized courier service that records delivery at the addresses first given above , or 24 (twenty-four) hours if delivered by e-mail at the following address: 
 
 To Company: [●] 
 To Designated Employee: at the e-mail address first given above 
 
 INDEMNITY 
 
 The Designated Employee shall indemnify and hold the Company , its d irectors, officers, employees and agents, harmless from and against any and all claims, actions, proceedings, costs, expenses, and/or damages instituted against or suffered by the Designated Employee, on account of third party claims arising out of the use of the Vehicle by the Designated Employee or any breach of any covenant, representation and/or warranty stipulated under this Agreement and misstatement/concealment of facts by the Designated Employee. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 Neither Party to this Agreement shall be liable for the failure to perform any of its obligations hereunder if on account of an event of Force Majeure as defined in Clause 13.2 below . 
 
 The term “Force Majeure” as used in this Agreement shall mean any acts of God, acts of the public enemy, acts of war, (declared or undeclared), riot or civil commotion, terrorism, explosions, floods, orders or acts of any Government Authority and laws, rules or regulations of any Government which wholly or in substantial part prevent the affected Party from performing its respective duties and obligations hereunder.. 
 
 
 MISCELLANEOUS 
 
 The Designated Employee shall not to assign any of its rights and/or obligation to any third party , which shall en s ure directly to the benefit of the Designated Employee . 
 
 If any provision of this Agreement or part thereof is found by any court or administrative body of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, unenforceable or illegal, the other provisions will remain in force. If any invalid, unenforceable or illegal provision would be valid, enforceable or legal if some part of it were deleted, the provision will apply with whatever modification is necessary to give effect to the commercial intention of the Parties. 
 
 No forbearance, delay of indulgence by either Party in enforcing the provisions of this Agreement shall prejudice or restrict the rights of either Party nor shall any waiver of its rights operate as a waiver of any subsequent breach and no right, power or remedy herein conferred upon or reserved for the Party is exclusive of any other, power or remedy available to the Party and each such right, power or remedy shall be cumulative.
